This is a senior-level software engineering role (5+ years) on Gopuff's Delivery Tech team, working remotely. The work covers backend services behind the on-demand delivery platform — driver pay and pricing, dispatch and optimization, ETA and routing, plus the Driver App. The core stack is Go, Java, Python, and Node.js for high-throughput microservices in an event-driven distributed architecture, Flutter on the app side, and Azure or GCP for cloud.
